FROM feat/1090-antigravity-yolo-default TO development
Closes #1090

Configure Antigravity CLI (`agy`) to run in zero-confirmation mode by default inside AGRO. Docker remains the isolation boundary.

- Add `alias agy='agy --dangerously-skip-permissions'` in `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` and `.agro/install/.zshrc`.
- Declare `bypassPermissionsFlag: "--dangerously-skip-permissions"` for `antigravity-cli` in `HARNESS_CATALOG`.
- Pre-seed `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` with `{"defaultPermissionMode": "bypassPermissions"}` in the image and on first boot when the file is missing.
- Document the sandbox aliases and pin the defaults in the harness catalog tests.
